scope: All 128 selected GEN7 qkd_host_pc_slice_die land_er[260] producer DAGs; source-only, no native/timing/simulation qualification
primitive_count_rule: One sticky detector state per instance; OR inputs, registers and ports are propagation aliases, not additional primitive detectors.

local_primitive.clear: asynchronous negedge rst_n where rst_n=host_r; PINCAP=1 host_r=host_rn, a plain posedge ck sample of selected host_rst_n face

set_predicates.context: a is registered land_es; n0 is landing queue occupancy. No simultaneous-pop exemption in source.
b is registered host_es; n1 host queue occupancy. Source joins overflow/header errors into one fault FF.
The 2b10 credit case alone faults; simultaneous launch/credit uses default no update.
ev/ew are registered real boot-demux normal completion_v/we; on and writes track actual launched static words.
er is registered u_boot.normal_er; this is incoming fault propagation, not a new detector leaf.

detector_dependencies.queue_state: q0/q1 each 4 entries; n0/n1 3-bit, w/r pointers 2-bit
detector_dependencies.normal_completion_origin: Actual controller completion observer through ES merge own phase, wrapper pin capture, completion ownerdemux. See boot_control_dependencies.

propagation_nodes.kind: nonsticky OR-register; fault input is sticky

propagation_nodes.clear: her async rs_q to0, own async rs_q to1; rs_q<=rst_n on ck
propagation_nodes.kind: phase-gated registered alias; this masks controller fault outside boot ownership
registered alias to upstream primitive ledger
propagation_nodes.primitive_reference: ../pc/primitive_inventory.json; coordinate pc_return_leaf owns detailed controller detectors and selected reset derivation

boot_control_dependencies.important: These states control whether a controller error can reach land_er. They are not OR-exported as land_er[260] causes. boot fault has its separate boot_fault/sfo path.
boot_control_dependencies.hbm_reset: Wrapper hbm_rn<=hbm_rst_n on ck; hbm_r=hbm_rn when PINCAP1; all boot state async hbm_r clear. Distinct from host reset.

completion_demux_fault.owners: 64-bit owner+wr,6-bit wp/rp,7-bit count; normal_completion_v<=!owner[rp], boot_completion_v<=owner[rp] only on valid retire

completion_check_fault.verified: latches1 only test_done&&test_ok&&retired==4&&empty&&!fault; reset0; not independently cleared on new boot_go in source

boot_test_status.storage: done/ok/cause state in qkd_hbm_boot_pc (terminal per transaction, not lifetime sticky fault FF)
boot_test_status.clear: async hbm_r; new start in IDLE/FIN clears done/ok/cause
boot_test_status.return_input: test_er registered from ctrl_er while !normal; ctrl_er includes ES merge ownership and wrapper pin capture

boot_control_dependencies.separate_routes: u_slice.boot_fault -> wrapper sfo via per-PC onehot. u_static.fault -> u_station.host_fault. Neither incoming station fault_i nor ES merge m_fault|emb_fault is an OR input to land_er.

missing_or_unqualified: Absolute boot/host/core/HBM phases, reset pulse widths and real first-use offsets are not established by source logic.
No native proof that selected macro views preserve every detector/storage state; source DAG only.
Controller er[260] expansion delegated to pc_return_leaf ledger; do not stop at CDC fault alias or count er_f as a separate detector.
Other selected ctrl_er bits260-downward have their own data/SECDED semantics; er[258] is separate data error and not OR input to host land_fault unless boot test consumes it.
Complete sticky-health-to-STATUS/host-retirement/admission integration and deadline model remains parent-owned.

suppression_classification.validity_obligation: A legal witness must satisfy actual selected command ownership/boot schedule/reset assumptions, assert a real detector predicate, and show its required observation is lost at STATUS/host retirement/admission. A raw unqualified er bit is not such an obligation.
suppression_classification.reason: ES merge directs controller er to HOST only while own; runtime own0 instead exposes er to embedding endpoint. Boot gates intentionally suppress normal responses before validated boot completion. Controller er_f source is sticky until its reset; it may survive boot gating and be observed later.
suppression_classification.recommended_action: Prove phase transition, pending/retirement drain and real reset ordering for selected schedule; do not bypass qualifiers or capture raw er to create faults on healthy boot.
